title: Browser Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your browser's privacy risk score from the settings you use, in Chrome, Firefox, Safari or any other browser. It scores features, not brands.
description: Evaluate your browser's privacy protection level with our comprehensive risk calculator. Get personalized recommendations to improve your online privacy and security based on your current browser setup and settings.

formula: let baseScore = 0; const clearScores = { 'on-close': 15, 'manual': 8, 'never': 0 }; baseScore += clearScores[clearOnClose] ?? 0; const trackingScores = { 'strict': 25, 'custom': 20, 'standard': 10, 'none': 0 }; baseScore += trackingScores[trackingProtection]; const cookieScores = { 'blocked': 20, 'limited': 12, 'allowed': 0 }; baseScore += cookieScores[thirdPartyCookies]; baseScore += Math.min(extensionsInstalled * 3, 15); const incognitoScores = { 'always': 10, 'frequently': 8, 'sometimes': 5, 'rarely': 2, 'never': 0 }; baseScore += incognitoScores[incognitoUsage]; baseScore += syncEnabled ? 0: 5; const signInScores = { 'no': 10, 'sometimes': 5, 'yes': 0 }; baseScore += signInScores[signedInAccounts] ?? 0; const locationScores = { 'blocked': 5, 'ask': 3, 'allowed': 0 }; baseScore += locationScores[locationSharing]; const privacyScore = Math.min(baseScore, 100); let riskLevel = 'High Risk'; if (privacyScore >= 80) riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; else if (privacyScore >= 60) riskLevel = 'Medium Risk'; else if (privacyScore >= 40) riskLevel = 'High Risk'; else riskLevel = 'Very High Risk'; const maxPossible = 100; const improvementPotential = Math.round(((maxPossible - privacyScore) / maxPossible) * 100); return { privacyScore, riskLevel, improvementPotential };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your browser privacy from the features and settings you use, not the brand of browser: whether it clears cookies and history when it closes, tracking protection settings, cookie policies, privacy extensions, private browsing habits, sync and signed-in accounts, and permission settings. Each factor is weighted based on its impact on your overall privacy protection.
tips: Set your browser to clear cookies and history when you close it; most browsers have this setting, and some do it by default
Enable strict tracking protection and block third-party cookies in your browser settings
Install essential privacy extensions like uBlock Origin and Privacy Badger
Use private/incognito mode for sensitive browsing, especially on shared devices
Regularly review and limit website permissions for location, camera, and microphone access

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy protection. Your browser setup provides strong defense against tracking and data collection.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy protection with room for improvement. Consider enabling stricter settings or adding privacy extensions.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Limited privacy protection. Your data is likely being tracked and collected. Immediate improvements recommended.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Minimal privacy protection. Your browsing activities are extensively tracked. Consider switching browsers and updating settings.
